Message:
nfsd: Don't set eof on a truncated READ_PLUS

If the READ_PLUS operation was truncated due to an error, then ensure we
clear the 'eof' flag.

Fixes: 9f0b5792f07d ("NFSD: Encode a full READ_PLUS reply")
